comment: Numeric attributes the real HN Algolia index accepts in numericFilters (its numericAttributesForFiltering setting). Verified live 2026-07-16: created_at_i and points are both accepted — Algolia restored points after removing it in the 2026-07 outage. Only attributes the app actually filters on are listed. The mock server enforces this whitelist so CI rejects queries the real API would reject; hn-client.contract.test.ts re-verifies each entry against the live API when RUN_CONTRACT_TESTS=1.
